pages.text: $(bold)Prison Realm$()$(br2)A legendary cursed tool. $(bold)Right-click the ground to place$() it as a small cube entity (its idle form). If a creature enters the $(bold)5×5$() area around it and $(bold)stays for more than 5 seconds$(), it is $(bold)dragged into the Prison Realm dimension$() and imprisoned — this $(bold)also works on players$().$(br2)The Prison Realm dimension is completely empty and $(bold)disables any active teleportation$(). Each Prison Realm is bound to a set of coordinates: an empty bedrock sphere with a $(bold)radius of 20 blocks$() is generated around those coordinates, and dragged-in creatures are teleported to the coordinates and sealed inside; coordinates are always kept at least 50 blocks apart.

After dragging in a creature, the Prison Realm transforms into its $(bold)sealed form$() (with a new texture) and will no longer seal other creatures.$(br2)Both forms can be $(bold)picked back up into your hand with right-click$() or $(bold)placed on the ground with right-click$() — only the $(bold)placer$() may pick one up; the sealed / idle forms show different textures in the inventory than they do in hand.$(br2)$(bold)Releasing$(): $(bold)right-clicking a sealed Prison Realm with the Inverted Spear of Heaven$(), or $(bold)shining Jacob's Ladder$() on a sealed Prison Realm, breaks the Prison Realm and releases the entity sealed inside; once released, the cage sphere is cleared and the coordinates are freed.
